subject: Re: Demo for Helios — expand to security & procurement
messages:
From: Anya Shah <anya@helios.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request — would like security + procurement included

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intros last week. We'd like to schedule a live demo of Redwood for our platform and procurement teams. This will be a larger run-through than the PoC — our security lead and procurement manager want to attend.

Attendees likely: Tom Ellis (platform), Priya Mantri (security), Luke Carter (procurement). Timezone mix: West Coast & London.

Can we do a 90–120 minute session that covers architecture and procurement terms? Prefer week of May 24 but we're flexible.

Thanks,
Anya
Anya Shah
Director of Product, Helios Financial
anya@helios.com

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo request — would like security + procurement included

Hi Anya — great to hear from you.

We can absolutely expand the run book to include security and procurement. A couple of quick notes:
- For architecture deep dive + procurement Q&A, we typically recommend 90 minutes, followed by a 30-minute procurement breakout if needed.
- Kimberly (security) and Marissa (solutions) are cc'd to confirm availability and any pre-read they want so we can tailor the agenda.
- Do you have any specific compliance artifacts you'd like covered (SOC2, data residency, audit logs)?

Proposed windows (PDT):
- Tue May 25: 10:00–11:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Thu May 27: 09:00–10:30 or 14:00–15:30

If those don't work given London participants, we can offer later PST slots and plan a split session. I will loop in Connor from infra once we know scope — if his team needs to be hands-on we may need an alternate date due to travel.

Rachel
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Rachel. Anya — appreciate the heads up. A couple internal asks from security's side:
1) Please confirm whether Helios requires a run-through of encryption-at-rest details and KMS integrations (we can demo a mock key rotation).
2) If there are specific data retention policies or audit windows, send them ahead so we can prepare logs examples.

In terms of length, 90 + 30 works. My calendar is open May 25 13:00–15:00 PDT and May 27 morning. If we need later coverage for London, I can join remotely but will need Marissa or Connor to own the live infra demo if it's outside business hours.

Kimberly Park

Quick note from infra — heads up that several members of my team will be traveling May 24–26 for a datacenter audit. If the demo requires a live walkthrough of private deployment topology we'll need to either:
- Move to May 27 or the following week, or
- Split into two parts: 60–75 minute architecture + security session on May 25 (UTC-friendly time) and a 30–45 minute infra deep-dive the next week when the traveling engineers are back.

If Helios procurement needs to see pricing commitment models I can also get Marissa to prep the dedicated-reservation examples and bring the cost scenarios to the procurement breakout.

Thanks all — that makes sense. We can't get everyone in the same room next week (travel + timezones) so splitting is fine as long as the procurement stakeholders see the pricing models in the same week.

Proposed plan from Helios:
- May 25: 10:00–11:30 PDT — Architecture + Security (main attendees: Tom, Priya)
- May 31: 09:00–09:45 PDT — Procurement breakout (Luke + procurement team)

Rachel — can you send calendar invites for those two windows and an updated agenda? Also add a short pre-read for compliance artifacts (Priya will review ahead of time).

Anya
